ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the prevalence of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the measures being taken to prevent it.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What measures are being taken to prevent Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on an important issue. By following the money and investigating the prevalence of Medicaid fraud, we can hold those responsible accountable and prevent further fraud.

ideas.title: The Federal Reserve Investigation: What Really Happened?
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the DOJ's decision to drop its criminal investigation into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell.
questions: Why did the DOJ drop its investigation?
What were the findings of the investigation?
ideas.insight: I suspect that there may be more to this story than meets the eye. By investigating the circumstances surrounding the dropped investigation, we can uncover the truth and hold those responsible accountable.
